# Stamped with Love

> Custom rubber stamps and personalized stationery for return addresses, weddings, business branding, and special occasions, featuring laser-engraved designs and self-inking options.

Founded by Theresa and Ben in New England, Stamped with Love specializes in handmade and custom-engraved rubber stamps, embossers, and personalized gifts. The company offers collections ranging from return address stamps and wedding designs to business branding solutions and fabric stamps for clothing.

## Key Topics

- Custom rubber stamps
- Return address stamps
- Personalized stamps
- Self-inking stamps
- Wedding stamps
- Business branding
- Logo stamps
- Custom embossers
- Personalized gifts
- Fabric stamps
- Teacher stamps
- Wood-mounted stamps
- Signature stamps
- Packaging stamps
- Monogram designs

## Core Collections

- [Collections Hub](https://stampedwithlovexoxo.com/collections): Main collections hub featuring return address, wedding, pet, teacher stamps and embossers.
- [Return Address Stamps](https://stampedwithlovexoxo.com/collections/return-address-stamp): Return address stamp collection with self-inking and personalized design options.
- [State Address Stamps](https://stampedwithlovexoxo.com/collections/state-return-address-stamps): State-specific return address stamps with customizable, durable designs.
- [Pet Return Address Stamps](https://stampedwithlovexoxo.com/collections/pet-return-address-stamps): Pet-themed return address stamps featuring dog breeds like Golden Retriever and Corgi.
- [Wedding Stamps](https://stampedwithlovexoxo.com/collections/wedding-stamps): Handmade wedding stamps with designs like The Yue and The Wesley for invitations.

## Business & Professional Stamps

- [Custom Logo Stamps](https://stampedwithlovexoxo.com/collections/custom-logo-stamps): Custom logo stamps for business branding in wood, self-ink, and various shapes.
- [Packaging Stamps](https://stampedwithlovexoxo.com/collections/packaging-stamps): Custom packaging stamps for ecommerce branding and business shipping supplies.
- [Signature Stamps](https://stampedwithlovexoxo.com/collections/signature-stamps): Custom signature stamps for document signing, check endorsement, and business use.
- [Teacher Stamps](https://stampedwithlovexoxo.com/collections/teacher-stamps): Teacher stamps for grading and classroom feedback with motivational designs.

## Personalized Stamp Types

- [Custom Wood Mounted Stamps](https://stampedwithlovexoxo.com/collections/custom-wood-stamps): Wood-mounted laser-engraved custom rubber stamps for personalized branding.
- [Fabric Stamps](https://stampedwithlovexoxo.com/collections/clothing-fabric-stamps): Fabric stamps for personalizing clothing and textiles with logos and names.
- [Library Stamps](https://stampedwithlovexoxo.com/collections/library-book-stamps): Personalized library stamps for marking book collections with unique designs.

## Embossers & Accessories

- [Custom Embossers](https://stampedwithlovexoxo.com/collections/embossers): Custom embossers with monogram designs for stationery and business branding.
- [Custom Book Embossers](https://stampedwithlovexoxo.com/collections/custom-book-embossers): Book embossers with Ex Libris designs for personalizing personal libraries.
- [Custom Marble and Wood Coasters](https://stampedwithlovexoxo.com/collections/custom-marble-and-wood-coasters): Laser-engraved marble and Acacia wood coasters with personalized monogram designs.
